description: This Java source file defines the ActionBarDisplayOptions class, an Android activity demonstrating how various ActionBar display options flags can be combined and manipulated programmatically. It includes UI setup, event handlers for toggling display options, and manages action bar tabs and navigation modes.

classes.name: ActionBarDisplayOptions
classes.description: An Android activity that demonstrates the configuration and toggling of various ActionBar display options, including icons, titles, custom views, and navigation modes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, inflates layout, sets up UI controls, action bar tabs, and navigation callbacks.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from resource.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events on UI controls to toggle various ActionBar display options and UI flags.

methods.name: onTabSelected
methods.description: Callback when a tab is selected; currently not implemented.

methods.name: onTabUnselected
methods.description: Callback when a tab is unselected; currently not implemented.

methods.name: onTabReselected
methods.description: Callback when a tab is reselected; currently not implemented.

methods.name: onItemSelected
methods.description: Handles item selection in the navigation mode spinner, changing the ActionBar navigation mode.

methods.name: onNothingSelected
methods.description: Handles no selection in spinner; no action.

methods.name: onNavigationItemSelected
methods.description: Handle action bar navigation item selection; returns false as default.
